posts.title: I built a tool so i could stop refreshing Steamworks: Steam WishList Pulse
posts.description: Indie devs keep refreshing Steam wishlist stats. I built Wishlist Pulse to track changes, detect anomalies, and send alerts, no more checking Steamworks manually.
